title: A high ideal multiple intersects a kernel in a prescribed kernel multiple
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], I a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], F a coherent module [pqf-def-coherent], H any module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and mu:F \to H a map whose kernel K is quasi-coherent. For each n>=0 there exists m>=0 such that I^m F \cap K \subset I^n K inside F. Products use recursive ideal powers and multiplication images [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk], and the containment holds on the section ranges over every open.

source.place: Tag 01YA, Artin-Rees inclusion used in Tag 01YB

proof.text: Apply coherent Artin-Rees to the monic inclusion K -> F. There is a uniform c with I^m F intersect K contained in I^(m-c) K when c<=m.
Choose m=c+n. The difference m-c is n; write the containment as a containment of section ranges for each open W. No annihilation hypothesis is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem coherent_kernel_ideal_intersection_bound
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    (F H : X.Modules) (μ : F ⟶ H)
    (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F)
    (hK : (kernel μ).IsQuasicoherent) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, ∀ W : X.Opens,
      Set.range ((idealModuleProductι (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).2 F).app W) ∩
          Set.range ((kernel.ι μ).app W) ⊆
        Set.range ((idealModuleProductι (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).2
          (kernel μ) ≫ kernel.ι μ).app W)
